strings.tagline: Gamified training to enhance robotic and human integrations
strings.overview: A network of 111 union training halls on one campus, each running the same adaptive protocol suite: a difficulty dial that holds the zone of proximal development, a skill graph that sequences practice, assessment gates that certify only unaided work, and a mentor fabric that fades its own scaffolding.
strings.map.legend: Each hall is coloured by its district; identity is carried by a three-letter code.
strings.honesty.taxonomy: This is a taxonomy of skilled trades, not a roster of chartered locals. No union has reviewed it and no local is named.
strings.honesty.modules: Module counts are addressable module IDs generated from an authored skeleton, not hand-written lessons.
strings.honesty.content: Lesson content is unverified general practice pending authoring by journey-level practitioners.
strings.honesty.translation: Hall names are kept in English pending reviewed trade-name translations.
strings.hint.campus: Click a hall to enter it
strings.hint.walk: WASD to move · Esc to exit
strings.geo.note: True bearings; distances compressed — labels carry real km
